question: 销售额高于品类平均销售额的品类有哪些？
sql:
SELECT p.category AS 品类, ROUND(SUM(o.order_amount), 2) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order o
JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20250331
GROUP BY p.category
HAVING ROUND(SUM(o.order_amount), 2) > (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(t.`品类销售额`), 2) AS `品类平均销售额`
  FROM (
    SELECT p2.category AS 品类, ROUND(SUM(o2.order_amount), 2) AS `品类销售额`
    FROM fact_order o2
    JOIN dim_product p2 ON o2.product_id = p2.product_id
    WHERE o2.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20250331
    GROUP BY p2.category
  ) t
)

SELECT d.year AS 年份, COUNT(f.order_id) AS 订单数
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.year = 2025 AND d.quarter = 'Q2'
GROUP BY d.year

question: 家用电器品类中销售额最高的前2个商品是哪些？
sql:
SELECT
  dim_product.product_id,
  dim_product.product_name,
  ROUND(SUM(fact_order.order_amount), 2) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order
JOIN dim_product ON fact_order.product_id = dim_product.product_id
JOIN dim_date ON fact_order.date_id = dim_date.date_id
WHERE dim_product.category = '家用电器'
  AND dim_date.year = 2025
  AND dim_date.quarter = 'Q1'
GROUP BY dim_product.product_id, dim_product.product_name
ORDER BY SUM(fact_order.order_amount) DESC
LIMIT 2

question: 销售额高于大区平均值的大区有哪些？
sql:
SELECT r.region_name AS 大区, ROUND(SUM(f.order_amount), 2) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE d.year = 2025 AND d.quarter = 'Q1'
GROUP BY r.region_name
HAVING SUM(f.order_amount) > (
    SELECT AVG(t.`销售额`)
    FROM (
        SELECT r2.region_name AS 大区, ROUND(SUM(f2.order_amount), 2) AS 销售额
        FROM fact_order f2
        JOIN dim_region r2 ON f2.region_id = r2.region_id
        JOIN dim_date d2 ON f2.date_id = d2.date_id
        WHERE d2.year = 2025 AND d2.quarter = 'Q1'
        GROUP BY r2.region_name
    ) t
)
ORDER BY 销售额 DESC
